sample: Synthetic reconstruction of the described 0.5-second cryptocurrency clipboard replacement loop; original artifacts unavailable from Forager.
new_claim: A repeated clipboard read is bound to a wallet regex test, then replaced by a fixed spendable Ethereum address in that branch.
placement: objectives/impact/crypto-manipulation/clipboard; required overwrite supports modification, not credential acquisition or mere collection.
nearest_alternative: Generic clipboard read/write APIs remain micro-behaviors/os/clipboard. A one-shot wallet UI copy and an unrelated input test do not satisfy the new rule.
languages_and_platforms: Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; portable pyperclip/clipboard and browser clipboard operations on Windows and Unix. No family, domain, filename or recipient identity gates.

taxonomy_relocation.matcher_and_scope: Preserved all 11 definitions and scripts/binaries, Windows/Unix scope. Local references are resolved at the new home.
taxonomy_relocation.criticality_correction: Nine atomic format observations and the Litecoin union change baseline to notable because they are useful address-format evidence, not universal program behavior. multi-crypto-regex remains notable.
taxonomy_relocation.consumers: Five exact consumers updated. The two broad credential-access selectors in ide-mcp retain the 11 moved IDs explicitly, with unchanged any:1 cardinality and span semantics. The original 50-member crypto-address selector in clipboard-hijacker is made explicit to exclude newly relocated members. Rust keyword selector cannot consume scripts/binaries-only moved rules and requires no expansion.
taxonomy_relocation.fixture: address-patterns.py covers all nine atoms and multi-crypto-regex; litecoin-regex is additionally checked with test-rules. no-address-patterns.py is a prose-only near miss.

detection_corrections: ETH validation matcher recognizes three equivalent hex class orders, including lowercase classes commonly used with case-insensitive regex flags.

py-clipboard-wallet-btc now requires an actual clipboard read and a call with an entire Bitcoin-shaped literal argument; ETH substrings, comments and docstrings no longer qualify. The neutral call observation is notable in os/clipboard/write.

indicator_summary.excluded: SHA256-derived XOR key, legitimate Chocolatey and ipinfo.io, Python filenames, legitimate dependencies
